fusions.name: Wrung Droplet
fusions.desc: Flicks a thread-wrapped bead of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapped Up
fusions.desc: Lashes a sticky thread at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach.

fusions.name: Spring Snare
fusions.desc: Sets a coiled thread trap beside the nearest enemy, where it waits up to 20 seconds. The first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles take 16 damage in a blast 2.5 tiles across and are [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Reserve
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina runs out, a coiled thread springs loose and restores 10 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
